key_findings.shared_omission: Instruction lesson does not explicitly contrast scheduler issue interval with warp per-instruction interval; readers may connect the paired Scheduler lesson.
key_findings.critical_root_cause_note: The same lg_throttle versus data-dependency confusion occurs in three baseline claims, not three independent failures.
key_findings.interpretation: One material metric-meaning error and its propagation into a reader diagnostic answer were avoided. Scheduler and pure arithmetic tasks show no measured gain.

ocr.synthetic_real_vision: Spatial binding detects wrong-row/wrong-value claims; missing percent units stay unresolved despite OCR confidence 1.0.
ocr.actual_resolution: Host AI inspected original/cropped pixels and official definitions; no semantic pass from OCR.
ocr.rejected_development_experiment: 2x/3x/4x interpolation produced more OCR regions but corrupted labels and digits; not shipped.

costs.extra_review_and_prompt_cost: not controlled; no token billing measurement

reproduction: Original reader programs executed unchanged on frozen cases and additional variants; this is teaching-program reproduction, not an original GPU kernel rerun.
